text:
ashley: FYI — Acme legal forwarded a customer question about CVE-2024-4897 in 'dataproto' (transitive). They want impact, mitigations, SBOM, and an ETA for remediation.

dinesh: Copy. Which services pull dataproto at runtime? any exposed parsing endpoints?

paul: Inventory quick check: hosted API frontend and the private runtime plugin include dataproto v1.2.3 via sdk v4. Hosted path doesn't parse untrusted JSON blobs in inference path. Private deployments may expose more surfaces.

emma: CVE notes: CVSS 7.5 remote deserialization, PoC requires authenticated admin API access. Immediate mitigations: disable remote-config endpoint, tighten RBAC, and block unauthenticated admin traffic. Recommend KMS rotation only as defense-in-depth.

dinesh: I'll create a triage ticket and add SBOM export as an action item. Can we confirm 'no exploitable path' for hosted so we can tell the customer? I'll own the evidence pack.

ashley: Customer specifically asked "does this ever touch key material in KMS?" They run Dedicated + Private. Need a short statement.

paul: Short answer: we do not hand plaintext key material to dataproto. Control-plane data sent to dataproto is metadata/JWE only. For Private deployments, customer-managed KMS is reachable by their control plane but dataproto doesn't receive keys. Recommend optional KMS key rotation for their peace of mind. I'll draft a statement.

security-bot: Automated scan flagged dataproto v1.2.3. Remediation: upgrade to v1.2.6 (fix in 1.2.5+), or apply patch #432. Suggested PR title: "chore(deps): bump dataproto 1.2.3 -> 1.2.6". Include SBOM diff.

emma: Risk & timeline: P2 for hosted (monitoring + config fix), P1 for private (customer-facing). Proposed: disable remote-config in hosted canary within 24h, private deployments patch/rollout within 3 business days, full evidence pack (SBOM + statement + ticket links) in 48h.

dinesh: Opening remediation ticket now, tagging eng-oncall/legal. Assigning private rollout to @sam.

sam: ACK. Starting canary today for hosted, will open PR and post rollout status here (will include canary metrics).

ashley: I'll send interim reply to customer: "We're triaging; no evidence of exploit; private deployments prioritized; full evidence pack ETA 48hrs." Any edits? :thinking_face:

paul: Add "we do not expose KMS key material to the vulnerable component" sentence.

ashley: Sent. Customer responded :thumbsup:. They asked for SBOM export next. @dinesh please attach.

dinesh: SBOM export uploaded to Zendesk #5123. Triage ticket INF-7894. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/9876. Will update ticket with legal wording and KMS sentence.

ashley: Thanks team — will close the loop with Acme once we have the PR and SBOM link.
